purpose: Follow-up to v5: hierarchical neural regional totals with count-conserving allocation; target MAE <500 on known 2021-2022 development target
population: Same eligible complete months and all California cells as v1/v4/v5. No CAL FIRE or VIIRS input features.
architecture: Learn north/south total corrections from fixed count-weighted feature pooling or learned query/key/value attention over MODIS cell features. Count-conserving allocation is either baseline-relative or bounded neural local reallocation. Training-only seasonal ratio anchor; no boosted teacher.
features: V5 fine feature subset, excluding neighbor/history descriptors. Region features include fixed count-weighted fine descriptors, total count magnitude, active-cell fraction and concentration. Learned attention is a pooling Transformer block, not a pretrained language model.
optimizer: MPS required; AdamW lr .001, weight_decay .03, cosine .0001 floor over320 epochs, dropout .15, gradient clip5, eight full months per batch
loss: Same v5 local Poisson plus presence BCE plus statewide/regional smoothL1 monthly loss. All terms optimized jointly on full-month batches.
selection_rule: Epoch chosen on 2019-2020 ensemble MAE. Refit2013-2020, select config on2021-2022 only. Seal selection before new winner benchmark predictions. No tuning on2023-2025.
limits: V5 selection outcomes motivate this architecture, so repeated historical selection is explicitly exploratory. Regional sums can improve while allocating missed detections to the wrong cells; report local and zero-input errors. No prospective claim or production promotion.
